dataset: NOAA GOES-18 (GOES-West) ABI L2 Land Surface (Skin) Temperature, Full Disk hourly (ABI-L2-LSTF), from s3 noaa-goes18
purpose: Ground/skin-temperature proxy, substituted because all ERA5/ERA5-Land mirrors were blocked (see raw/reanalysis/MANIFEST.json). NOT soil temperature: clear-sky skin temperature only.

derived.derived_goes18_lstf_points.csv: nearest pixel (and 3x3 mean of DQF<=1 pixels) to P_A 51.08N 114.17W and P_B 51.03N 114.14W; both points fall in row 86/87 col 686 (adjacent pixels, ~10 km product grid). Script: /home/claude/bsfm/scripts/goes_extract.py
